    # y[i,j] = 1 if both nodes in the pair are selected.
    # "for every pair of nodes, a binary variable indicates whether both nodes in the pair are selected"
    model.y = pyo.Var(model.P, within=pyo.Binary)

    # r = the minimum distance between any two selected facilities.
    # "maximizing the minimum distance between any two selected facilities"

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(expr=model.r, sense=pyo.maximize)

    return model
